tool_summary: Extracts files from a ZIP archive.
platform_notes: The Info-ZIP implementation is standard across most POSIX systems; behavior regarding symlinks and permissions can vary slightly between distribution versions.

rules.description: The -o flag forces the overwrite of existing files without prompting. This can lead to permanent loss of current file versions.
The -X flag restores original UID/GID and permissions from the archive. If run as a privileged user, this could be used to create setuid binaries or alter system file ownership.
rules.reversible_note: Depends on whether the original permissions are known and whether elevated permissions were granted.

rules.description: The -l flag lists the contents of a ZIP archive without extracting files to the filesystem.
